title: Let Me Introduce Myself
summary: Siswa belajar menyapa, memperkenalkan diri dan teman, serta menanyakan nama, umur, dan alamat memakai am/is/are dan kata tanya Wh-.
content:
## Tujuan Belajar

• Menyapa orang lain dan membalas sapaan dalam bahasa Inggris.
• Memperkenalkan diri sendiri dan memperkenalkan teman.
• Menanyakan dan memberi informasi pribadi: nama, umur, dan alamat.
• Membuat pertanyaan dengan What, Where, When, dan Who.

## Kosakata Inti

Di unit ini kamu belajar kata-kata untuk menyapa, berpamitan, dan bercerita tentang dirimu: nama, umur, kelas, ulang tahun, dan tempat tinggal. Perhatikan contoh berikut.

Good morning! My name is Rina. I am 12 years old and I am in 7th grade.
I live in an apartment on Melati Street. It is close to my school.
My birthday is in May. Goodbye, see you tomorrow!

## Tata Bahasa: am / is / are dan Kata Tanya Wh-

Kata kerja "to be" (am, is, are) dipakai untuk menyebut identitas, umur, kelas, perasaan, dan fakta tentang seseorang. Pasangkan subjek dengan bentuk yang tepat. Untuk kegiatan yang sedang terjadi sekarang, pakai am / is / are + kata kerja berakhiran -ing.

I → am
He / She / It / satu nama → is
You / We / They / banyak orang → are

I am in 7th grade.
She is twelve years old.
They are new students.
My address is 15 Kenanga Road.
We are waiting for our teacher. (sedang terjadi sekarang)

Untuk menanyakan informasi, pakai kata tanya: What (apa), Where (di mana), When (kapan), Who (siapa). Pertanyaan dengan is / are tidak memakai do / does.

What is your name?
Where do you live?
When is your birthday?
Who is your English teacher?

## Contoh Percakapan

Dina: Good morning! I'm Dina. What's your name?
Raka: Hi, Dina! My name is Raka. Nice to meet you.
Dina: Nice to meet you, too. How are you today?
Raka: I'm fine, thank you. I'm a new student in 7th grade.
Dina: Me too! How old are you?
Raka: I'm twelve years old. My birthday is in June.
Dina: Where do you live?
Raka: I live in a house on Mawar Street. It's far from school.
Dina: This is my friend, Sari. She lives close to the school.
Raka: Hello, Sari! Goodbye for now, see you tomorrow!

## Ayo Berlatih

What is your name and how old are you?
Contoh: My name is Fajar. I am 13 years old.

Where do you live?
Contoh: I live in an apartment on Anggrek Road.

When is your birthday?
Contoh: My birthday is in October.

Can you introduce your friend?
Contoh: This is Nadia. She is in 7th grade. She is a new student.

## Tips

• Ucapkan "Good morning" sebelum jam 12 siang dan "Good afternoon" setelahnya. Saat berpisah, pakai "Goodbye" atau "See you tomorrow".

• Latih pola I am / He is / They are dengan memperkenalkan dirimu dan anggota keluargamu di depan cermin setiap hari.

questions.q: Choose the correct word: Mr. Smith _____ an 8th grade teacher.
questions.explanation: Mr. Smith = satu orang (he), jadi memakai is.

questions.q: Choose the correct word: Sarah _____ in 7th grade.
questions.explanation: Sarah = she, jadi memakai is. 'am' hanya untuk I.

questions.q: Choose the correct word: The students _____ waiting.
questions.explanation: The students = banyak orang (they), jadi memakai are.

Choose the correct word: They _____ new students.

questions.passage:
Good afternoon! My name is Aria, and I am in 7th grade. Today is my first day at a new school. I am a little nervous, but I am also excited.

I am 12 years old and my birthday is in August. I live in an apartment on Green Street. It is close to the school, so I walk every morning.

Right now, I am waiting in front of the classroom for our teacher, Mr. Smith. A girl is smiling at me. She says, “Hi! I’m Amanda. What’s your name?” I feel fine now because I am making a new friend.
